integration_metadata.title: Model 1 Checkpoint Fix — Controlled Integration Report
integration_metadata.summary: Switched default Model 1 checkpoint in app/backend/config.py from legacy models/model1_expanded/best_model.pth to retrained models/model1_retrained_v3/best_model.pth. Generated and verified isolated V3 crop prototypes. Validated end-to-end regression suites and tested the live running backend API with 95.0% accuracy on audited failure cases.

pipeline_audited_and_representative_crop.tomato: 9/10 accepted and correctly predicted as tomato (97.7% - 100.0% conf); 1 flagged as uncertain_crop (no apple misclassification)
pipeline_audited_and_representative_crop.strawberry: 10/10 accepted and correctly predicted as strawberry (99.1% - 100.0% conf) and diagnosed by Model 2
pipeline_audited_and_representative_crop.bellpepper: 5/5 accepted and correctly predicted as bellpepper (99.6% - 100.0% conf) and diagnosed by Model 2
pipeline_audited_and_representative_crop.apple: 5/5 accepted and correctly predicted as apple (94.7% - 100.0% conf) and diagnosed by Model 2

remaining_limitations: cherry_tomato (idx 13) and gypsophila (idx 26) remain empty classes in data/processed/model1_expanded/ with zero training samples; safely represented as NaN in prototypes.
Isolated heavy lesion spots on tomato leaves (such as Google bacterial leaf spot sample 0040) have low prototype similarity and trigger uncertain_crop rejection rather than false classification.

rollback_instructions.step_1: In app/backend/config.py, set MODEL1_CHECKPOINT back to PROJECT_ROOT / 'models' / 'model1_expanded' / 'best_model.pth'.
rollback_instructions.step_2: In app/backend/config.py, set MODEL1_PROTOTYPES back to PROJECT_ROOT / 'models' / 'model1_expanded' / 'crop_prototypes.npz'.
rollback_instructions.step_3: Restart uvicorn server. The preserved byte-for-byte legacy checkpoints and prototypes will immediately reactivate.
